what: The deployed configuration of the Lotka-Volterra quadrature field, and the sweep that chose it. Every value was selected by the measurement named beside it, not by default.

architecture.why_depth: 8 blocks. Depth is the lever that pays and it SATURATES here: 3 blocks reaches 0.47 of a per-instance oracle, 6 reaches 0.81, 8 reaches 0.83, and 12 reaches 0.79 with half again the parameters. 6/8/12 are within single-seed noise of one another; 3 is not.
architecture.why_not_wider: Width HURTS. At 3 blocks, hidden 128 (803k params) and hidden 192 (1.66M) score BELOW hidden 64. The map was too shallow, never too small.

optimization.why_lr: 1e-4. The learning rate outweighs the schedule: 1e-3 costs a factor of about 2.4, 1e-4 beats 3e-4, and tripling the steps at a fixed rate buys only 1.21x.
optimization.why_not_bigger_batch: 32 observations per step is indistinguishable from 8. Measured twice; the first time on a validation signal too noisy to resolve it, which is why it was re-measured.

validation.why: Two defects were found here and both mattered more than any architecture choice. (1) The validation draws were unseeded, so the signal carried a fresh Monte-Carlo error of +-1e-3 against a total achievable improvement of 1.5e-3: early stopping ran on noise and the map stopped learning at step 200 of 8000. (2) Validation ran at M=128 ALONE, which the scoring bank resolves on one member of eight, while every reported number is at M=32.

data.why_all: Data is NOT the binding constraint. Training on 1,000 observations scores 180x where all 41,952 score 168x -- a fortyfold cut with no cost. Independently, the map scores BETTER on observations it never saw (200x) than on ones it trained on (109x), which rules out memorization.

fixed_throughout.why_float64: The ridged node Gram reaches a condition number of 2.45e12 and the score is a difference of order-one terms yielding a result near 1e-12. Re-solving in single precision BREAKS the never-worse inequality on 243 of 7040 draws; 80-bit extended changes nothing. The operating point is bracketed on both sides.

gain.note: Oracle depths are comparable only WITHIN one scoring run, since each run draws its own observations and seeds. Always quote the fraction, never the absolute multiple, across runs.
